sentences.en: I am aware that my hip aches when it rains.
sentences.zh: 我知道下雨时我的臀部会疼。

sentences.en: Two years ago, the patient obtained an artificial hip joint.
sentences.zh: 两年前，病人装了一个人工髋关节。

sentences.en: She advanced with a light step, moving her hips harmoniously.
sentences.zh: 她迈着轻盈的步伐，协调地扭动着臀部。

senses.zh: 熟悉内情的；非常时尚的
